page.overview:
Who is Thanquol?

Thanquol is arguably one of the greatest and most infamous Grey Seers the Skaven Under-Empire has ever known. A particularly favoured agent of the ruling Council of Thirteen and the arch-nemesis of the famed adventurers Gotrek and Felix, Thanquol has, across countless missions, commanded vast armies, sought valuable information and artefacts, supported the furtive activities of Clan Eshin, and attempted to incite insurrection among the enemies of the Skaven race. Ambitious and self-serving even by Skaven standards, Thanquol rarely misses an opportunity to employ his scheming guile to improve his own standing in his cutthroat society. He is a master at manipulating or conveniently "misunderstanding" orders to his advantage, turning rivals and allies alike against one another while ensuring that he reaps the rewards.

Thanquol is shrewd and constantly re-evaluates his plans, forever probing for new angles and opportunities from which he might benefit. That so many of his assignments end in spectacular disaster is, as he has repeatedly assured the Council, certainly no fault of his own. A Skaven of extraordinary cruelty, Thanquol has been responsible for considerable misery and mayhem among both his enemies and his fellow Skaven. Among his more audacious exploits was his ruthless seizure of supreme command during the Nuln Campaign, in which he sought to overthrow the city with a force of nearly 10,000 warriors and war-machines. The Grey Seer also came to the aid of the infamous Clan Moulder stronghold of Hell Pit during a horrific Chaos invasion, personally assuming command of the city's innumerable legions.

Though disgraced for his actions, Thanquol nevertheless demonstrated his characteristic cunning by crippling the immensely powerful city of Under-Altdorf, a rival Skaven settlement whose strength rivalled that of Skavenblight itself. Though once again condemned as a scapegoat by his masters, he was later instrumental in a successful expedition to the lush jungle-continent of Lustria, where he witnessed the total annihilation of the infamous Temple-City of Quetza, an event that led to the death of a Prophet of Sotek. Perhaps the greatest triumph the Grey Seer has ever known, however, came when he unwittingly participated in a magnificent ritual that resulted in the summoning of Skarbrand, the mightiest Bloodthirster to have ever lived, within the great Dwarf hold of Karak Angkul.

Thanquol also ventured to the mancity of Miragliano in Tilea, where he won over the furless burgomeisters to the Skaven cause by promising them power and eternal life. The witless fools proved only too willing to place their faith in his sorcery. Unfortunately, the warpstone dust Thanquol had given them to consume caused the burgomeisters to mutate, whereupon they were stoned to death by their fellow citizens.

Also known as: Grey Seer Thanquol.
